caseName: Motteler v. J. A. Jones Construction Co.
caseNameFull: Motteler, Administratrix v. J. A. Jones Construction Co.

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 7th Cir. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
